channel.title: GXZ — Intelligence, in motion.
channel.description: Research on people, space, and intelligent systems.

item.title: CrowdFlow AI
item.description: A research prototype connecting pedestrian trajectories, social-force simulation and entrance layouts to study how crowds move through public events.

item.title: GR00T × Isaac Sim
item.description: An engineering study of the path from robot demonstrations to policy inference and Isaac Sim control, developed from an open-source GR00T tutorial.

item.title: Sunken Plaza
item.description: An observational study of a campus sunken plaza, using site footage, 3D reconstruction and pedestrian visualization to examine the relationship between movement, pause and public space.
